DSS and LDSS Suite

Fusion Epoch presents CPR GF DSS Pre-Review, Open Water, Atmospheric Science LDSS and eExecutor.ai DSS. These systems are at different controlled development and release stages.

About Fusion Epoch

Fusion Epoch brings together Decision Support Systems and Learning Decision Support Systems for research, environmental measurement, education and professional work.

Each system is human-designed and AI-assisted, with human judgement retained in control.

Development is led by Professor Michael J Savage, Professor Emeritus, University of KwaZulu-Natal.
